security_audit.summary: The skill is legitimate documentation for the inference.sh CLI, but it includes security-sensitive installation and execution flows. The pipe-to-shell installer, dynamic binary download, PATH installation, broad infsh command execution, and X automation capabilities require strong user confirmation and safer installation guidance.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is executed through curl piped to sh.
remediation.suggestion: Remove pipe-to-shell instructions and make manual signed release downloads the primary install path. Require users to review commands before execution.

remediation.issue: Manual install uses shell command substitution to derive a binary URL from a remote manifest.
remediation.suggestion: Use explicit per-platform release URLs, signature verification, and a parser that fails closed instead of shell text pipelines.

remediation.issue: The skill permits broad infsh command execution, including remote app runs and account operations.
remediation.suggestion: Narrow allowed commands where possible and require explicit confirmation before app runs, deployments, task result retrieval, or credit-consuming operations.

remediation.issue: X automation commands can publish or interact through a user account.
remediation.suggestion: Add mandatory user confirmation before posting, sending DMs, following, liking, or retweeting, and clearly label these as account-affecting actions.

remediation.issue: Installation guidance writes a downloaded binary into a user PATH directory.
remediation.suggestion: Document the exact install path, checksum and signature checks, rollback steps, and the need for user approval before modifying PATH contents.

content.user_title: Run Cloud AI Apps with inference.sh
content.value_statement: Switching between AI model APIs slows down experiments. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code discover and run inference.sh apps through the infsh CLI.
actual_capabilities: Documents installation, login, update, and authentication flows for the infsh CLI.
Lists, searches, filters, and inspects inference.sh apps by category or query.
Generates sample inputs and runs apps with inline values or input files.
Tracks long-running tasks and saves app results when supported by the CLI.
Covers image, video, LLM, search, audio, 3D, utility, and X automation examples.
Links reference files for authentication, app discovery, running apps, and CLI commands.
limitations: Requires an inference.sh account and local infsh CLI authentication.
Remote app runs can consume account credits and send inputs to external services.
The skill does not verify each app provider, privacy policy, price, or output quality.
Installation examples include remote downloads that users should review before execution.

use_cases.title: Prototype AI Model Workflows
use_cases.description: Find suitable inference.sh apps, inspect their inputs, and run quick experiments from an agent session.

use_cases.title: Generate Creative Assets
use_cases.description: Run image, video, audio, and 3D generation apps without managing local GPU infrastructure.

use_cases.title: Operate Cloud AI Tasks
use_cases.description: Submit long-running jobs, check task status, and save results from the infsh command line.

prompt_templates.title: Find an App
prompt_templates.prompt: Find inference.sh apps for image generation and explain which one is best for a fast product concept.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to inspect an inference.sh app, generate a sample input, and run it after I approve the command.

prompt_templates.title: Track a Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me submit a long-running video generation job, capture the task ID, and check the result later.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Multi-Model Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare image, video, search, and LLM apps for a campaign workflow, then propose a step-by-step execution plan with approval points.

output_examples.input: Find a fast image generation app for a product concept.
output_examples.output: Recommended a FLUX app, explained expected inputs, and identified when to use a sample input file before running.

output_examples.input: Run a video generation task without waiting for completion.
output_examples.output: Prepared a command plan, noted the approval point, and described how to check the task status later.

output_examples.input: Choose a search app for current market research.
output_examples.output: Compared Tavily and Exa options and suggested the best app based on answer style and extraction needs.

best_practices: Review installer commands and prefer signed manual downloads before adding binaries to PATH.
Check app schemas, expected cost, and data handling before running remote jobs.
Require explicit approval before account-affecting actions such as X posts, deployments, or long-running paid tasks.
anti_patterns: Piping a remote installer to a shell without inspection or verification.
Running social automation commands without a clear user-approved message and target account.
Saving API keys, prompts, generated files, or task outputs into shared repositories by accident.

faq.question: What does this skill help me do?
faq.answer: It helps agents use the inference.sh infsh CLI to find apps, run cloud AI tasks, and track results.

faq.question: Does it require an inference.sh account?
faq.answer: Yes. You need an account and authenticated CLI session or API key for most app runs.

faq.question: Can it run image and video models?
faq.answer: Yes. The references include examples for FLUX image models, Veo video models, and other media tools.

faq.question: Can it use LLM and search tools?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill lists OpenRouter, Claude model routes, Tavily, Exa, and related app discovery commands.

faq.question: What should users approve before running commands?
faq.answer: Users should approve installation, remote app runs, paid tasks, deployments, file writes, and social account actions.

faq.question: Is the installer risk-free?
faq.answer: No. The documented pipe-to-shell installer is risky and should be replaced with reviewed signed downloads.
